channel.title: Global Africa Network Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Africa Network Media (globalafricanetwork.com)

item.title: Redesigning informal trade: From survival to sustainable growth
item.description: From spaza shops to street-side food vendors, the informal sector employs up to 42% of our workforce and contributes as much as 6% of GDP, according to recent estimates.

item.title: Gauteng launches fund to drive the province’s re-industrialisation
item.description: The Manufacturing Support is a term loan facility of up to R5-million, specifically designed to support enterprises that are at least fifty-one percent (51%) black owned.

item.title: Durban secures over R1.9-billion investment commitment to establish Africa’s first superyacht hub
item.description: Navigo has confirmed its commitment to mobilise significant private-sector investment towards Durban's superyacht infrastructure and refit capabilities, with projected investment estimated at over R1.9-billion.

item.title: Large-scale onshore salmon farming operation in the Northern Cape in progress
item.description: Southern African Atlantic Salmon (SAAS) aims to establish the first large-scale onshore Atlantic salmon farming operation in South Africa, using cutting-edge Norwegian flow-through technology.

item.title: Opportunities for developers and investors in the aviation industry at UIA
item.description: The climate and space for aircraft storage, the viability for green (solar) energy and a greenfield site to construct a state-of-the-art facility make Upington International Airport a favourable location for an MRO facility.

item.title: Untapped tourism investment opportunities in the Free State
item.description: The Free State Province is home to several strategic and unique natural and cultural assets that offer significant opportunities for tourism investment through strategic partnerships.

item.title: Ekurhuleni Aerotropolis – creating a world-class gateway to global markets
item.description: The visionary Ekurhuleni Aerotropolis initiative is one of the most exciting development opportunities in South Africa today. Find out more about it here.

item.title: Northern Cape highlights compelling investment opportunities
item.description: In preparation for the upcoming Northern Cape Investment and Jobs Conference, Northern Cape Premier, Dr Zamani Saul highlights several key opportunities that are driving investors to the Northern Cape.

item.title: An investment location strategically positioned to benefit from regional corridor development and tourism
item.description: In the region surrounding the municipality, the N2 Wild Coast development as well as the Eastern Seaboard development will have an impact on the future economic activity in and around the Mnquma municipal area.

item.title: Spotlight on West Coast District Municipality (WCDM)
item.description: Growth opportunities abound in renewables (wind/solar farms), green hydrogen, aquaculture, agro-processing, eco-tourism and educational or health investments in the West Coast District Municipality.
